name: Benthic microcrustaceans
description: Tiny crustaceans browsing the surfaces of plants and algal mats - twelve chydorid water fleas (Sida, Scapholeberis, Alona and kin) and six bottom-dwelling copepods (harpacticoids and cyclopoids). Functional group pooling the source's 18 benthic cladoceran and copepod taxa, which share the same diet and predators in the source web.
